title: Reservation sizing experiments, canaryed burst-governor rollout, and tenant synthetic validators
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: This ticket captures the remediation plan and follow-ups from the 2026-02-18 dedicated-cluster capacity incident where a small set of tenant workloads triggered prolonged KV-cache stalls and rapidly consumed burst credits. Root cause hypothesis: (1) reservation sizing math underestimated multi-modal sequence lengths for several tenants, (2) our burst-governor allowed aggressive soft-burst draws without fast replenishment, and (3) we lacked tenant-level synthetic validators that would have detected the noisy pattern earlier. Goal: run controlled reservation shrink/expand experiments, implement a canaryed rollout of a new burst-governor with ramp controls, and add tenant synthetic validators + KV-stall alerting to prevent regressions.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Maya Chen: Postmortem complete (link below). Prioritized three tracks: experiments to validate reservation sizing delta, a conservative burst-governor with backoff curves, and tenant-level synthetic validators (honeypot requests). Assigned ENG+Infra to own experiments.

2026-03-01 - Arjun Patel: Experiment harness prototype in /tools/reservation-experiments; added telemetry hooks to emit reservation utilization histograms and per-tenant burst-consumption timelines. Initial run on canary pool showed expected utilization shift but KV-stall rates increased for a single tenant; hypothesis: longer tail sequences triggered KV eviction churn.

2026-03-03 - Lena Ortiz (SRE): Dashboards updated (Datadog) to show KV stall rate, burst-credit balance, and reservation headroom. Added anomaly alerts: kv_stall_rate > 0.5% sustained 2m in any pool triggers P1 notification.

2026-03-06 - Design review (Priya Kapoor): UX for console rollout: expose per-tenant reservation experiment status and allow customer success to opt-out of canaries. Agreed to require explicit opt-in for high-impact tenants.

2026-03-08 - Engineering review (Samir Rao): Proposed burst-governor algorithm accepted with caveat: need a ramp factor and emergency soft-fence if a tenant consumes >75% of pooled burst for >30s. Action: implement soft-fence and add end-to-end tests.

2026-03-10 - Arjun Patel: Github PRs opened: serving PR #13421 (burst-governor with ramp + soft-fence), infra PR #4021 (experiment harness + synthetic runner). Running integration tests on staging; initial canary scheduled 2026-03-15.

2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Raised a blocker: dedicated GPU quota for the experiment pool is constrained next week; working with capacity planning to reserve an additional 6 GPUs for 72h window. If not approved, canary will be delayed 10 days.
